name: openbb_regulators_sec_search
description:
Search SEC-registered institutions (13F filers such as fund managers) by name through the OpenBB Platform (obb.regulators.sec.institutions_search); results carry name and CIK.
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): query*; provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts sec only; schema default sec, but when omitted the tool sends yfinance, which this command rejects, so set it); no key.
Company search: edgar_company_search, openbb_equity_search (provider sec); holdings: edgar_institutional_holdings. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"query": "Vanguard", "provider": "sec"}
